about: Ordered deploy steps for Northwind Sales Hub. via=iq: a SharePoint IQ tool call; via=rest: SharePoint REST against {{SiteUrl}} (Accept/Content-Type application/json;odata=nometadata); via=manual: a person does it. Resolve every double-brace token before a call (see site/site.json 'tokens'). Steps are idempotent-safe to re-run except uploads with overwrite=false. Tested end to end on a fresh dogfood communication site on 2026-11-25 (see docs/setup-walkthrough.md).

steps.title: Create a communication site (any URL) and make the deployer an owner
steps.notes: Any route works: SharePoint start page, admin center, New-PnPSite, or SharePoint IQ create_site (get_site_key on the tenant root, then create_site with sitecreationprecheckOnly=true to check the address, then the real call with siteType CommunicationSite and a sensitivity label). The new site's default home page is blank; step 09.11 replaces it. Tested 2026-11-25: IQ create_site made a new communication site in about 30 seconds.

{"internalName": "Industry", "displayName": "Industry", "type": "MultiChoice", "choices": ["Healthcare", "Financial services", "Retail", "Manufacturing", "Public sector", "Cross-industry"], "metadataExtractionPrompt": "Which industries does this content target? Use Cross-industry if it is not industry-specific."}
{"internalName": "AISummary", "displayName": "Summary", "type": "Note", "metadataExtractionPrompt": "Summarize this asset for a seller in two sentences: what it is and when to use it."}

{"internalName": "SuggestedShareability", "displayName": "Suggested shareability", "type": "Choice", "choices": ["Internal only", "Customer-shareable (NDA)", "Public"], "metadataExtractionPrompt": "Based on the content, how widely could this be shared? Internal only if it has internal pricing, roadmap or confidential markings; Public if it is marketing material; otherwise Customer-shareable (NDA)."}

{"internalName": "ValidationResult", "displayName": "Validation result", "type": "Choice", "choices": ["Pass", "Fixable", "Blocked"], "metadataExtractionPrompt": "Review this document against these rules. Northwind Cloud publishing standards: (1) current product names only: Northwind Data Platform, Northwind Secure Access, Northwind AI Studio, Northwind Field Service, Northwind Analytics; the retired names Northwind DataHub, SecureGate and Northwind Insights must be replaced. (2) every statistic, percentage or ROI claim needs a source on the same slide or page. (3) internal pricing, discount levels, roadmap dates or text marked Internal only or Confidential must never appear in customer-facing content. (4) a named customer needs the note 'Reference approved'. (5) competitor mentions must be factual and never disparaging. (6) customer-facing decks and documents must include the line 'Northwind Cloud confidential. Subject to change.' (7) no personal data such as personal phone numbers or personal email addresses. (8) every slide or section has a title. Return Blocked if internal-only content appears in customer-facing material, a named customer lacks 'Reference approved', or personal data is present. Return Fixable if there are only other issues. Return Pass if there are no issues."}

{"internalName": "ValidationFindings", "displayName": "Validation findings", "type": "Note", "metadataExtractionPrompt": "Review this document against these rules. Northwind Cloud publishing standards: (1) current product names only: Northwind Data Platform, Northwind Secure Access, Northwind AI Studio, Northwind Field Service, Northwind Analytics; the retired names Northwind DataHub, SecureGate and Northwind Insights must be replaced. (2) every statistic, percentage or ROI claim needs a source on the same slide or page. (3) internal pricing, discount levels, roadmap dates or text marked Internal only or Confidential must never appear in customer-facing content. (4) a named customer needs the note 'Reference approved'. (5) competitor mentions must be factual and never disparaging. (6) customer-facing decks and documents must include the line 'Northwind Cloud confidential. Subject to change.' (7) no personal data such as personal phone numbers or personal email addresses. (8) every slide or section has a title. List each issue on its own line starting with [Fixable] or [Blocker], naming the slide or section. If there are no issues, write 'No issues found.'"}
